design.name: 沙葬弩尸
design.brief: A desert-buried undead crossbowman of the bandit faction: a lanky, slightly hunched sun-bleached skeleton partly wrapped in tattered sand-coloured grave bandages, a torn crimson bandit waist sash with the faction's gold spiral emblem on its hanging strip, a broken wide-brimmed woven desert hat with a ragged hanging cloth veil at the back, teal-green ghost-fire glowing in both eye sockets and a small teal-green ghost flame burning inside its visible ribcage, a bone quiver full of bone bolts strapped diagonally across its back, worn bronze bracers on the forearms, one leather shoulder guard. Bony hands with a clearly separate bony thumb and four long separate bony finger bones each. Bony feet with five separate toe bones, partly wrapped in cloth.
design.weapon: a heavy bronze-and-bone repeating crossbow with a skull-shaped stock
